about: What the editor knows about each enemy. Claude regenerates this from the prefabs (rewards, lives) when they change.

enemies.name: basic
enemies.does: A brainwashed soldier in a gas mask. Runs straight at you.

enemies.name: worm
enemies.does: A mechanical drill worm. Tunnels under you and leaps up to catch you in the air.

enemies.name: rock thrower
enemies.does: A squat robot with two claws. Keeps its distance and lobs scrap at random spots around you.

enemies.name: giant
enemies.does: A 4 m combat robot with a steel girder. Needs a double jump to stomp.

enemies.name: archer
enemies.does: A half-robot with a crossbow arm. Keeps its distance and shoots bolts where you're about to be.

enemies.name: sniper
enemies.does: A soldier with a long rifle. Keeps its distance; its red laser follows you, then locks, and a moment later the shot flies along it.

enemies.name: parry guard
enemies.does: A soldier with two bracers. Now and then it glows yellow: hit it with a melee weapon then and you are stunned.

enemies.name: stalker
enemies.does: A fast soldier you can hardly see: only its two eyes glow, and now and then its outline shimmers. It shows itself just before it hits you, and for a moment when you hit it.

enemies.name: suicide drone
enemies.does: A small flying bomb with two rotors. Flies at you at head height, beeps and flashes red, then dives and blows up. Stomp it and it bounces you high: a stepping stone up to a giant's head.

elites.does: Bigger and gold, in helmet and shield, with a longer girder. Swings faster when enraged.
Longer and gold, 10 armour plates, leaps higher.
Bigger and gold, in helmet and shield. Shoots volleys of 3 bolts, 5 when enraged.

THE COLOSSUS, the last boss (a first version): the giant 2.4 times as big. Its body barely feels hits; stomp its HEAD 3 times to kill it (it kneels every 12 s, its head down at 5 m), and each time it throws you off.
